tools.name: get_download_links
tools.description: Returns a stable list of official app links. Pass all for iOS, Android and web, or select one platform.

platform.description: Exact platform selection. Omit or pass all to return every official link.

tools.name: get_journal_article
tools.description: Returns the title, summary, publication date, keywords and canonical URL for one published Journal article selected by its exact slug.

tools.name: get_mcp_connection_details
tools.description: Returns the official remote OAuth MCP endpoint, documentation URL, authentication model, scopes and authenticated task-tool names. The task tools are not public marketing-site WebMCP tools.

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: Returns The One Thing product name, purpose, proposition, accessibility features, supported platforms, plan summaries and canonical homepage URL.

tools.name: list_journal_articles
tools.description: Returns published Journal articles newest first. An optional topic performs a case-insensitive substring match across each title, description and keyword.

topic.description: Optional case-insensitive substring, for example ADHD, focus, dyslexia or motivation.

tools.name: open_journal_article
tools.description: Navigates this browser tab to one published The One Thing Journal article selected by its exact slug. It does not change user data.

tools.name: open_task_app
tools.description: Navigates this browser tab to The One Thing web app sign-in or sign-up page. It does not sign in, read tasks or change task data.

destination.description: Whether to open the existing-account sign-in page or new-account sign-up page.
